dataset: ATR DIAMOR preprocessed trajectories and manual group annotations
license: research use only; cite ATR references

scope.partial_or_nonpositive_group_policy: quarantine every recoverable positive member id
scope.negative_mobility_aid_policy: parse the documented -2/-3 type prefix and quarantine recoverable positive group partners
scope.multiple_id_annotation_policy: parse recoverable ids, quarantine the subject aliases and group partners
scope.one_sided_or_conflicting_membership_poli: quarantine the transitive closure of every affected annotated group

query.name: mean_within_dyad_distance_m
query.cardinality_conditioning: true dyad count q is disclosed; memberships are hidden
